Omnibus line positions and labels for each shown panel.

Source: R/plot-composition-contrasts.R
build_omnibus_marks.Rd

The ratio panel's label carries the decision statistics (the permutation p-value, or PPGT1 and R_PPGTnope under Bayes); the energy panel's label carries \(E\) and, under Bayes, E_PPGTnope. Each label sits on whichever side of its line has more room within the panel, counting the reference line, so the panel edge does not clip it.

Usage

build_omnibus_marks(result, long_data, statistic_labels, shown_labels)

Arguments

result

A HellingerEnrichmentResult.

long_data

Output of stack_plot_statistics.

statistic_labels

Named panel labels (ratio, energy).

shown_labels

Panel labels present in the plot.

Value

data.frame with statistic, value, label, and hjust.
